content: Orot Afiy Kakafih Hitounbubur Ma’am Jesu Iyawas
Jesu ana bai’ufununayah bairi harew Galilee hirabon hina tafaram Gerasa imaim hitit.
Jesu wa wanawanan tit bisure auman, mar ta’imonamo orot ta afiy kakafih hitounbubur ma’am rahane tit na biyan tit.
Iti orot i rahamaim in ma reremor, naatu sabuw murab fokarih anababatun hifafatum men karam.
Anayabin mar etei an uman murab fokarihimaim tefafatumen, baise eyi erab an uman murab tetoro’oro’omen naatu aur tetatafofor, fair kwanekwan men karam boro hitarouh.
Fai mar rahamaim naatu oyawemaim in ma itar koukuw taiyuwin biyan agimamaim bobeyabeyaten reremor.
Jesu no ef yokaika nan itin, nunuw in nanamaim ra’iy sun yowen.
Naatu fanan aumetawat na’in iwow eo, “O ayu biyau’umaim abisa kukokok, Jesu God auyom ma’ama’anin Natun? God wabinamaim abifefeyan men biyababan initu’umih!”
Anayabin Jesu iu, “O afiy kakafin orot biyanane kutit!”
Naatu Jesu ibatiy, “O wab i abistan?” Orot iya’afut eo, “Ayu wabu i ‘Kou’ay,’ anayabin aki i nai moumurih na’in.”
Naatu Jesu fefeyan kikin men hikok boro tiyafarih hitatit tafaram nati hitihamiy.
For burut kakafin nati yubin heher ta sisibinamaim hima hi’u’ufar.
Afiy kakafih Jesu hifefeyan hio, “Karam boro iti yafari atan for wanawanah atarun?”
Jesu afiy kakafih baibasit itih, orot biyanane hitit hin for wanawanah hirun, for 2,000 na’atube heher sisibin hinunuw hira’iy harew yan hire hi’ar tomatom himorob.
Orot iyab hima for hibituw hinunuw hin bar merar gagamin naatu bar merar afa hai tur hi’owen. Naatu sabuw abisa mamatar itininamih hitit hina.
Hina Jesu biyan hitit hinuwanuw orot afiy kakafih hitounbububur ma’am, i boun ana not rumutufur faifuw gewasin iyoun mare ma’am hi’i’itin ana maramaim hibir.
Sabuw iyab matah yan orot afiy hitounbububur ma’am isan mi’itube mamatar, naatu for isah abisa mamatar hi’i’itan sabuw hai tur hi’owen.
Naatu sabuw Jesu hifefeyan hai tafaram baihamiyinamih hiu.
Jesu wa afe’en yenamih orot afiy hitounbububur ma’am na Jesu ifefeyan hairi namih.
Baise Jesu men ibasit, naatu orot iu, “O kwen a bar hinat tamat naatu taituwa, Regah ana gewasin o isa sisinaf naatu ana kabeber bit i hai tur ku’owen.”
Basit orot nati’imaim ihamiyih Bar Merar Etei Umat Roron imaim remor Jesu mi’itube biyawas sabuw hai tur eowen, naatu sabuw hinonowar i hifofofor men kafaita.
Jairus Natun Babitai Naatu Babin Jesu Ana Faifuw Butubun
Jesu ibanak maiye wa isra’at rabon harew rounane hitit, naatu re riy sisibin bat, imaibo sabuw moumurih na’in hina hi’arbebera’uh.
Naatu Kou’ay bar ana ukwarin orot wabin Jairus na tit, nuw Jesu i’itin ana maramaim na anamaim ra’iy.
Naatu fefeyan kikin eo, “Ayu natu babitai i emomorob, akokok inan umamaim au kek biyan inabutun saise nayawas!”
Naatu Jesu orot Jairus hairi hin, sabuw himour kwanekwan hibi’ufunun naatu yaten hiyey.
Wanawanahimaim i babin ta, baibin hai sawow bai ma kwamur etei 12 sawar.
I’akir manin na’in, adanafur bowayah ta ta isah run tit kabay gagamin na’in ibaiyanih, baise men yawas ta tita’ur ana sawowone i rara’at sasa.
Jesu ana tur nowar, naatu sabuw wanawanahimaim inan babin Jesu ufunane tit ana faifuw butubun.
Anayabin i na’at not, “Ayu ana faifuw ana butubun boro ana yawas.”
Naatu bubutubun mar ta’imonamo rara nununuw nutanub naatu biyan wanawanan naniyan tatatam nati bai’akirane yawas.
Jesu fair biyanane titit i naniyan tatam, sabuw wanawanahimaim tatabir ibatiyih, “Yait ayu au faifuw butubun?”
Ana bai’ufununayah hiu, “O sabuw moumurih na’in yate teyey, naatu baise o kubibat, yait ayu butubuni?”
Baise Jesu bat inuwanuw menatan sisinaf itininamih.
Naatu babin biyanamaim abisa mamatar i so’ob, imih tit Jesu nanamaim ra’iy an uman hi’oror mi’itube isan mamatar etei eorerereb.
Naatu babin iu, “Natu, o abaitumatumamaim iyawasi, tufuwamaim kwen, a bai’akirane o arufami kutitit.”
Jesu bat eo’o auman, sabuw afa Kou’ay Bar orot ukwarin ana barene hina Jairus hiu, “O natu babitai i morob, Bai’obaiyenayan men inarowenbibibir.”
Abisa hio Jesu nowar, natu Jairus iu “Men inabir o initumatum.”
Sabuw etei eotanih hima, i Peter, James naatu John akisihimo iuwih bairi hin.
Hina Jairus ana bar hititit ana veya sabuw yababan gagamin na’in buwih fanah aumetawat na’in hima hirererey Jesu nowar.
Naatu bar wanawanan run sabuw iuwih, “Kwa aisim kwarererey? Iti kek i men morobomih, i matan fot inu’in.”
Baise sabuw Jesu eo isan himarib. Naatu Jesu sabuw iuwih ufun hitit, kek hinah tamah naatu ana bai’ufununayah akisihimo hirun hin kek inu’inumaim hitit.
Kek babitai umanamaim bai naatu iu, “Talitha koum!” Nati anayabin i iti na’atube, “Babitai kafai o au’uwi kumisir!”
Mar ta’imonamo babitai misir an yan bat remor, babitai ana kwamur 12 iti mamatar i hi’oror sa’ir hai kasiy ra’at hifofofor men kafaita.
Jesu ofafarih uwih eo, “Men sabuw hai tur kwana’owenamih, bay kwabai babitai kwaitin eaan.”
